name: Altinkilic Gida ve Sut Sanayi Ticaret A.S.
summary: Established in 1991, Altinkilic Gida Ve Sut Sanayi Ticaret A.S. is a Turkish company specializing in the manufacture and distribution of dairy items, including milk, various cheeses, and yogurt, across Turkey. The firm's main operations are situated in Istanbul.
